h1: WEIGHTS · A Model Name Against Its Weights
title: WEIGHTS | A Model Name Against Its Weights | Heuremen LLC
desc: WEIGHTS: whether the most downloaded open-weight models on Hugging Face keep the same weight files behind the same name, pass after pass.
intro_html:
Does a model name keep the same weights?

A Hugging Face repository name is a pointer. Anyone who pins a model by name expects the weight files behind it to stay the same. We read the weight files of the 1,000 most downloaded models and read them again on later passes. A model is the same when its weight files are identical on two passes, changed when a weight file was replaced, added or removed, and gone when the repository no longer resolves.
note_html: Source: the Hugging Face API, root folder of the main branch, content hashes recorded by Hugging Face. The changed share is read against a band of 0 to 1 percent, open at 1 percent, and 1 percent is also the size that matters. It is CONSISTENT when the whole 95 percent interval sits inside the band and ABOVE when the lower end is at or above 1 percent. Otherwise it reads cannot tell, with the reason beside it. This rule is in a plan addendum dated 12 November 2026, committed before any reading under it. The first pass has nothing to compare with and reads cannot tell (NO_INTERVAL_FORMABLE). The count of failed reads and the share of cannot tell by reason sit under the first table. Why a file changed is not measured here. Weights in subfolders and gated repositories are not read. Every changed model is listed after it is read in full. Plan, addenda and code.
